data.reason_zh: 提出FSM分解地址与执行记忆，由遗忘研究发现驱动设计，冻结并追加执行器供后续阶段使用，符合方法纳入。

scope_support.feedback_quote: Guided by this finding, we introduce Factorized Skill Memory (FSM)
scope_support.object_quote: we introduce Factorized Skill Memory (FSM), which separates continual skill memory into a plastic Address Memory and a stable Execution Memory.
scope_support.persistence_quote: At each stage, FSM trains a new LoRA executor using only current-stage data, freezes it after acquisition, and appends it to Execution Memory
